description:
Air pressure at an altitude, by the International Standard Atmosphere.

    Use for: 'air pressure at altitude', 'atmospheric pressure at 1000m',
    'pressure at elevation', 'air pressure calculator', 'hpa at altitude'.

    At 1,000 m the standard pressure is 89,875 Pa (898.75 hPa), about 89% of
    sea level. Valid to 20,000 m.

    Args:
        altitude: Height above sea level.
        unit: m, ft or km.
        sea_level_pressure_pa: Sea-level pressure, default 101,325 Pa.
        sea_level_temperature_k: Sea-level temperature, default 288.15 K.

    Returns:
        Pressure in Pa, hPa, kPa, atm and mmHg, the share of sea level, and
        the standard temperature.
name: air_pressure_at_altitude_calculator
